datasets.name: Bijie open-source dataset
datasets.verbatim: Part of the data consists of the Bijie open-source dataset (Ji et al., 2020), which was created for landslide segmentation.

datasets.name: Remote sensing images from 91 wemap software
datasets.verbatim: In this study, we obtain remote sensing images of landslides from 91 wemap software and Bijie open-source database (Ji et al., 2020).

datasets.name: Landslide dataset (combined and pre-processed)
datasets.verbatim: The datasets presented in this study can be found in online repositories. The names of the repository/repositories and accession number(s) can be found below: https://github.com/Abbott-max/dataset; doi:10.4121/20401740.

methods.name: Dynahead-Yolo
methods.summary: An object detection model based on YOLOv3 that incorporates a dynamic head module. The dynamic head module integrates scale-aware, space-aware, and task-aware attention mechanisms to improve feature extraction and detection of landslides with variable proportions and complex backgrounds.

availability.author_statement: Data availability statement has shared links.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is linked via a GitHub repository, but the custom code for the Dynahead-Yolo method is not mentioned or provided in the artifact availability information.
